summary: financial report fetcher and aging now fall back to a full-page heuristic when the API omits meta.total_pages, instead of stopping after page 1.
reason: Both loops continued only while meta.total_pages was present. If Productive omits total_pages on these endpoints, recognized-revenue/invoiced/reconcile understated totals and aging under-reported unpaid buckets past the first 200-row page. Now: use total_pages when present, else stop only on a short (<page[size]) page.
validated_outcome: recognized-revenue and aging return correct live data after the change; unit tests pass.
